concepts.title: Inner function on the unit disk
concepts.description: A bounded holomorphic function on the unit disk whose radial boundary values have modulus one almost everywhere on the unit circle.

concepts.title: Inner–outer factorization in Hardy H²
concepts.description: Every nonzero H² function is the product of an inner function and an outer H² function; the factors are unique up to opposite unimodular constants.

concepts.title: Inner-product C*-module
concepts.description: A semi-inner-product C*-module with ⟨x,x⟩=0 only for x=0. Its norm is ∥x∥=∥⟨x,x⟩∥¹ᐟ²; completeness is not assumed.

concepts.title: Interior of a subset of a topological space
concepts.description: The interior of A is the union of all open subsets contained in A.

concepts.title: Intersection body of a star body
concepts.description: The star body IK with radial function ρ_IK(u) equal to the (d−1)-dimensional volume of K∩u⊥.

concepts.title: Inverse function theorem in Euclidean space
concepts.description: A continuously differentiable map between open subsets of ℝⁿ whose derivative is invertible at a point restricts near that point to a C¹ diffeomorphism. A C^k or smooth map has an inverse of the same regularity.

concepts.title: Jackson approximation theorem on the sphere
concepts.description: For a λ-Lipschitz real function f on S^{n−1} and positive integer k, a real polynomial P of degree at most k satisfies sup_{S^{n−1}}|f−P|≤Cλn/k for an absolute C.

concepts.title: Jacobian matrix of a differentiable Euclidean map
concepts.description: For f:ℝⁿ→ℝᵐ, its Jacobian matrix at a point has entries ∂f_i/∂x_j. For m=n its determinant is the Jacobian determinant.

concepts.title: Jordan curve theorem
concepts.description: A simple closed curve in the plane separates the plane into exactly two connected components, one bounded and one unbounded, and is the boundary of both.

concepts.title: Klartag’s linear-size isomorphic Minkowski symmetrization theorem
concepts.description: For n≥2 and a convex body K⊂ℝⁿ, at most 5n Minkowski symmetrizations produce a centrally symmetric body K̃ with (1−c|log log n|/√log n)M*(K)B₂ⁿ⊆K̃⊆(1+c|log log n|/√log n)M*(K)B₂ⁿ, for an absolute c. In particular its outer radius is at most an absolute multiple of M*(K).

concepts.title: Klartag’s quantitative Minkowski symmetrization theorem
concepts.description: For n≥2, 0<ε<1/2 and a nonempty compact convex set K⊂ℝⁿ with M*(K)=M₀, at most cn|log ε| Minkowski symmetrizations produce K̃ with (1−ε)M₀B₂ⁿ⊆K̃⊆(1+ε)M₀B₂ⁿ, for a universal c.

concepts.title: Bochner connection Laplacian on tangent vector fields
concepts.description: The rough or connection Laplacian ∇*∇ on tangent vector fields, defined from covariant differentiation and its formal L² adjoint. In the selected surface problem it is the weak operator associated to the squared norm of the tangential covariant derivative, not the Hodge Laplacian on differential forms.

concepts.title: Lebesgue differentiation theorem
concepts.description: Almost every point of a locally integrable function on ℝⁿ is a Lebesgue point.

concepts.title: Lebesgue measure on Euclidean space
concepts.description: The completion of the Borel measure on ℝⁿ assigning each rectangular box the product of its side lengths.

concepts.title: Lebesgue point of a locally integrable function
concepts.description: A point x is a Lebesgue point of f if the average of |f(y)−f(x)| over balls centered at x tends to zero as their radii tend to zero.

concepts.title: Limit inferior of an extended-real sequence
concepts.description: For a sequence (a_n), liminf a_n=sup_N inf_{n≥N}a_n, allowing infinite endpoints.

concepts.title: Limit of a real function at a point
concepts.description: The relation lim_{x→a}f(x)=L means that for every ε>0 there is δ>0 such that 0<|x−a|<δ in the domain implies |f(x)−L|<ε.

concepts.title: Linear map between vector spaces
concepts.description: A map between vector spaces over the same field preserving addition and scalar multiplication.
